model_sql:
with split_tags as (
    select
        c.customer_id,
        unnest(string_split(c.tags, ',')) as raw_tag
    from {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} as c
    where c.tags is not null
)
select
    customer_id,
    rtrim(ltrim(raw_tag)) as tag
from split_tags
